# Rabea Shaban (ربيع شعبان / ربيع الزيات) | Full Stack Software Engineer Portfolio

This is the official portfolio website of Rabea Shaban (also known as ربيع شعبان, ربيع الزيات, ربيع شعبان الزيات, Rabea Elzayat, Rabea Elzayate, Rabea Sh Elzayat, rabea-shaban, and @rabea_sh_elzayat). Rabea is a professional Senior Full Stack Software Engineer and Cloud Architect specializing in MERN Stack development, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Cloud Architecture (AWS), and DevOps practices (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform).
